query:
INSERT INTO users (
                       id,
                       github_id,
                       github_login,
                       avatar_url
                       )
                       VALUES (
                               $1,
                               $2,
                               $3,
                               $4
                               )
                        ON CONFLICT (github_id)
                       DO UPDATE SET
                          github_login = EXCLUDED.github_login,
                          avatar_url = EXCLUDED.avatar_url,
                          updated_at = NOW()
                          RETURNING
                              id,
                              github_id,
                              github_login,
                              avatar_url,
                              created_at,
                              updated_at
